proof_body:
by
  intro n a x σ ha hx
  have hanti : Antivary a (fun i => x (Fin.rev i)) :=
    ha.antivary (hx.comp_antitone Fin.rev_anti)
  have hdown := hanti.sum_mul_le_sum_mul_comp_perm (σ := σ.trans Fin.revPerm)
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Fin.revPerm_apply, Fin.rev_rev] at hdown
  exact ⟨hdown, (ha.monovary hx).sum_mul_comp_perm_le_sum_mul⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a x : Fin n → ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), Monotone a → Monotone x → ∑ i, a i * x (Fin.rev i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * x (σ i) ∧ ∑ i, a i * x (σ i) ≤ ∑ i, a i * x i
